card.description: A towering 12‑meter obelisk carved from obsidian and basalt, etched with intricate Ethiopian and Egyptian hieroglyphic motifs. At its apex sits a pulsating crystalline core that emits bio‑luminescent light, channeling energy into a network of copper conduits radiating from the base. Surrounding the obelisk is a ring of stone pillars, each bearing a different ancient symbol that glows faintly when the core activates, creating a dramatic interplay of light and shadow in a grounded, industrial‑mystic setting.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Monolithic obelisk, 12 m tall, carved from obsidian and basalt, base ring of stone pillars with etched glyphs.
**Face/Sensors:** Pulsating crystalline core at apex, bio‑luminescent glyphs, copper conduits radiating from base.
**Key Features:** Glowing glyphs, crystalline core, copper conduits, stone pillars, photorealistic texture detail.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Activation): Core dormant, glyphs dim, conduits dark.
Phase 2 (Full Power): Core glows intensely, conduits light up, glyphs flare with bio‑luminescent glow.
